model.name: R19.54: Users become first-class scenario units (ior:class:User) in the scenario index.
model.description: Each User MUST be a first-class scenario unit (ior:class:User) stored at scenario/index/<shard>/<userUuid>.scenario.json with the standard {ior, model, ownerIor} shape, unitLinks[], and statusChecklist. Migrate existing data/profiles.json entries into per-user scenario units (backup-gated). After migration, code reads/writes user data via scenario units; profiles.json becomes deprecated/derived. Includes: (a) ior:class:User class definition, (b) server code reads/writes via scenario units, (c) one-time migration (backup before).
model.tronQuote: > TRON: "users and devices still have to be converted to standard first class scenarios."
model.crossRefNote: R19.1 (room as scenario unit) established the pattern. R19.35 (Room.members[] IOR refs) points to User units — R19.54 ensures those pointees actually exist as scenario units. R19.39 (RawBin system user) is also a User unit.
